mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saving_product ( financial_institution_id, product_code, product_name, join_method, join_target, join_restriction, special_condition, maturity_interest, max_limit, notice, disclosure_month, disclosure_start_date, disclosure_end_date, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{financialInstitutionId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{joinMethod}, #{joinTarget}, #{joinRestriction}, #{specialCondition}, #{maturityInterest}, #{maxLimit}, #{notice}, #{disclosureMonth}, #{disclosureStartDate}, #{disclosureEndDate}, #{submittedAt} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE saving_product_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(saving_product_id), product_name = new.product_name, join_method = new.join_method, join_target = new.join_target, join_restriction = new.join_restriction, special_condition = new.special_condition, maturity_interest = new.maturity_interest, max_limit = new.max_limit, notice = new.notice, disclosure_month = new.disclosure_month, disclosure_start_date = new.disclosure_start_date, disclosure_end_date = new.disclosure_end_date, submitted_at = new.submitted_at
mapper.select: SELECT sp.saving_product_id AS savingProductId, fi.financial_institution_name AS financialInstitutionName, sp.product_name AS productName, option_rate.max_interest_rate AS highestInterestRate, option_data.save_term AS saveTerm, option_data.reserve_type AS reserveType, sp.max_limit AS maxLimit, sp.join_method AS joinMethod, CASE WHEN sp.join_restriction IN ('2', '3') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasJoinRestriction, CASE WHEN sp.special_condition IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sp.special_condition) <> '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasSpecialCondition FROM saving_product sp INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON fi.financial_institution_id = sp.financial_institution_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT saving_product_id, MAX(max_interest_rate) AS max_interest_rate FROM saving_option GROUP BY saving_product_id ) option_rate ON option_rate.saving_product_id = sp.saving_product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT saving_product_id, save_term, reserve_type FROM saving_option ) option_data ON option_data.saving_product_id = sp.saving_product_id ORDER BY option_rate.max_interest_rate DESC, sp.saving_product_id ASC, option_data.save_term ASC, option_data.reserve_type ASC

SELECT sp.saving_product_id AS savingProductId, fi.financial_institution_name AS financialInstitutionName, sp.product_name AS productName, sp.join_method AS joinMethod, sp.join_target AS joinTarget, sp.join_restriction AS joinRestriction, CASE WHEN sp.join_restriction IN ('2', '3') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasJoinRestriction, sp.special_condition AS specialCondition, sp.maturity_interest AS maturityInterest, sp.max_limit AS maxLimit, sp.notice AS notice, sp.disclosure_month AS disclosureMonth, sp.disclosure_start_date AS disclosureStartDate, sp.disclosure_end_date AS disclosureEndDate, fpl.product_page_url AS productPageUrl FROM saving_product sp INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON fi.financial_institution_id = sp.financial_institution_id LEFT JOIN financial_product_link fpl ON fpl.financial_institution_id = sp.financial_institution_id AND fpl.product_type = 'SAVING' AND fpl.product_code = sp.product_code AND fpl.link_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE sp.saving_product_id = #{savingProductId}

SELECT saving_option_id AS savingOptionId, saving_product_id AS savingProductId, interest_rate_type AS interestRateType, reserve_type AS reserveType, save_term AS saveTerm, base_interest_rate AS baseInterestRate, max_interest_rate AS maxInterestRate FROM saving_option WHERE saving_product_id = #{savingProductId} ORDER BY save_term ASC, reserve_type ASC, interest_rate_type ASC
